name: Wind-dried persimmon
summary: Persimmons hung in controlled wind until they are very sweet, chewy, and fragrant.
origin: Wind-dried persimmon, a famous Da Lat specialty. A March 2025 Lam Dong science bulletin names hồng treo gió Đà Lạt among OCOP strengths.
texture: Hung in controlled temperature, humidity, and wind, the dried fruit stays very sweet, soft and chewy, and fragrant.
taste: The fruit that goes to the drying line is ripened until yellow. The dried sweet is a soft, fragrant chew.
howToEat: Buy it to take home, or see the drying at the orchards.
One season line is late October and November. Another puts the crunchy season from September through December.
where: Along Trần Hưng Đạo, through Khe Sanh, to the end of Mimosa Pass, where the orchards sit on both sides. Lê Vân garden is on Mimosa.
priceBand: Check on arrival. The innovation center says liên hệ and does not print a đồng figure.
